first in goals and assists in the Bundesliga with 3 goals and 3 assists in 2 games. He also appeared as a right winger in the third round of the Bundesliga and assisted Mandzukic's goal. After that, he threw knife passes to Mandzukic or Pizarro several times, but could not lead to a goal. He also came on in place of Ribery in the second half of the Champions League match against Valencia, and considering his consistent rotation, strong stamina, and ability to score or assist goals, it seems [...] In the first leg of the UEFA Champions League quarter-finals against Real Madrid CF at home , he started as the central striker in place of the injured Robert Lewandowski , but displayed his worst performance. Failing to create any significant attacking opportunities and playing listlessly, he was eventually substituted. Although Müller has been occasionally tested as a lone striker for both club and national team, it has never been effective. This is because Müller is closer to a shadow [...] He played full time in the group stage first leg of Auckland City. He scored two goals and one assist and scored 250 goals in Bayern Munich. The team won 10: 0.  
  
He was briefly substituted before the quarterfinals against Paris Saint-Germain . This was his last game in Bayern, as the team lost 0-2 due to the unfortunate injury of Jamal Musiala .  
  
2024-25 season: 49 games (19 starts) 8 goals and 7 assists
